children: BCB Bancorp announced definitive agreements to sell problem loan portfolios totaling about $205.3 million and will record an estimated $43.3 million pre-tax loss in Q3 2026.
Agreed to sell problem loans with aggregate unpaid principal balance of ~$205.3M as of June 30, 2026.
Portfolios include $180.7M commercial & multifamily, $14.8M C&I, and $9.8M construction loans.
Estimated pre-tax loss of $43.3M will be recorded in third quarter of 2026.
Five of six transactions have closed; the final sale is expected to close before quarter-end.
Each sale agreement is independent; Hilltop Securities advised and Arnold & Porter served as legal counsel.
